title: Senior Backend Engineer
text:
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to design and scale our core APIs.
You'll own service reliability, write clean, well-tested Python or Go, and mentor junior engineers.
Experience with distributed systems, PostgreSQL, and cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) is a big plus.
You'll partner closely with product to ship features end-to-end, from design doc to production rollout.

title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer
text:
Build and maintain the infrastructure that powers our ML models in production.
You'll work on model serving, feature stores, and data pipelines at scale.
Strong Python skills and familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD are expected.
Experience with vector databases or retrieval-augmented generation systems is a plus.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer
text:
Join a small team shipping a consumer product used by thousands daily.
You'll move across the stack: React/TypeScript on the frontend, Python/FastAPI on the backend.
We value engineers who can go from a rough idea to a shipped feature with minimal hand-holding.
Bonus points for experience with payments (Stripe) and background job systems (Celery, Redis).
